rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose everyday noun for an idea or personal view.

example.english: I think this notion is pretty good.
example.jyutping: ngo5 gok3 dak1 ni1 go3 nam2 faat3 gei2 hou2

rows.note: Use this for an abstract concept or a more defined intellectual idea rather than a casual thought.

example.english: This notion is too abstract for children.
example.traditional: 呢個概念對小朋友嚟講太抽象喇。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 goi3 nim6 deoi3 siu2 pang4 jau5 lei4 gong2 taai3 cau1 zoeng6 laa3

rows.note: Use this when the notion is specifically someone’s expressed opinion or view.

example.english: What’s your notion about this matter?
example.jyutping: nei5 deoi3 ni1 gin6 si6 jau5 me1 ji3 gin3

rows.note: Use this when the notion is an intention or plan to do something.

example.english: We have a notion to move house next month.
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 daa2 syun3 haa6 go3 jyut6 bun1 uk1
